title: Volume of Solid with Square Cross-Sections
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: A solid has base bounded by y = sqrt(x), the x-axis, and x = 4. Cross-sections perpendicular to the x-axis are squares. Find the volume.

steps.title: Determine Cross-Sectional Area A(x)
steps.explanation: Side length of square is s = sqrt(x), so area is s^2.

steps.title: Set Up and Evaluate Volume Integral
steps.explanation: Integrate A(x) from x = 0 to x = 4.
